title: ReleaseStockReservation
description: Command (ADR 0006). Sent by order-service through its outbox (topic = this name, key = orderId). Consumed by inventory-service. Ends the order's stock lifecycle (cancel, reject, timeout). RESERVED lines are released; CONFIRMED lines are returned to stock when restock is true (RETURNED), otherwise stay sold (BR-ORD-09). The first release fixes restock. Allowed before any ReserveStock (leaves a closed order so a late reserve is rejected). Group inventory-release-stock-reservation. Answered by StockReservationReleased.

merchantId.description: Owner of the order's store. inventory scopes every read and write by merchantId + storeId.

orderId.description: Saga id and Kafka key; one order belongs to one store (BR-ORD-01).

restock.description: true when the goods can be sold again; set by order-service automatically for auto-reject and customer cancel before ACCEPTED, by the store otherwise.

reason.description: Free code for logs and movements, e.g. CUSTOMER_CANCELLED, STORE_REJECTED, PAYMENT_TIMEOUT.
